name: COSRX Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser 150ml Daily Mild Face Cleanser for Sensitive Skin with BHA & Tea-Tree Oil, PH Balancing | Korea
description:
COSRX Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser 150ml | Korea

Start and end your day with COSRX Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser, a gentle yet effective daily cleanser designed for sensitive skin. Its low pH formula cleanses impurities without stripping the skin, helping refine texture, strengthen the skin barrier, and leave your skin luminous and refreshed.

Key Features:

Gentle Daily Cleanser: Suitable for morning and night use, ideal for all skin types.

Key Ingredients: Tea Tree Oil and BHA soothe, clarify, and strengthen the skin.

pH Balanced: Maintains skin’s natural slightly acidic pH for protection against irritants.

Skin-Friendly Formula: Hypoallergenic, dermatologist-tested, and free from parabens, sulfates, phthalates, and animal testing.

Benefits: Cleanses deeply, refines skin texture, protects skin barrier, and promotes clear, radiant skin.

Enjoy clean, balanced, and luminous skin every day with COSRX Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser.
